title: win-click PostMessage tier: focusless on elevated MFC HTS (nfrunlite)
desc: win-click 3-tier cascade achieves focusless clicks on elevated MFC HTS (nfrunlite/nkrunlite) via PostMessage WM_LBUTTONDOWN to deepest child. Admin Eye proxy handles UIPI elevation barrier transparently. Tested on Heroes Global toolbar, grid, MDI areas.
steps: [TIER 2 PostMessage] win-click TARGET x y probes UIA (Tier 1) then PostMessage WM_LBUTTONDOWN/UP to ChildWindowFromPointEx deepest child. No focus steal, no popup. Works on AfxControlBar110, MDIClient, MFC child classes. Admin Eye proxy routes PostMessage for elevated processes (UIPI transparent). Output: FocuslessClick(PostMsg).
[FLAGS] --fl = Tier 2 max, fail if PostMessage also fails (no physical fallback). --dbl = WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK sequence. --right = WM_RBUTTONDOWN/UP. All 3 skip UIA Tier 1 (UIA has no dbl/right concept).

[TESTED nfrunlite 2026-04-25] AfxControlBar110 (480,67) toolbar: FocuslessClick(PostMsg) PostMsg at client (476,20). MDIClient (271,296) grid. Window at 0,0 full-screen so window-relative == screen coords. Find with: wkappbot a11y find {proc:nfrunlite}
[POPUP EXCEPTION] Stacked #32770 reconnect popups still fail from user-space UIPI. For popups use dismiss_popup_safe.py with IsWindowVisible filter. Normal MFC controls work via PostMessage.
[WHY OLD APPROACH FAILED] Previous ctypes PostMessage from non-elevated caller got err=5. wkappbot win-click routes via Eye pipe (admin proxy), so UIPI bypassed for normal controls.
